entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Before we talk about the data we got[n]from Sis, we need to discuss the incident[n]with the principal...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: People are already talking about it[n]online.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Nobody's saying it's 'cause of the[n]Phantom Thieves... so far.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: People think he did it because that[n]tabloid exposed how he was covering up[n]Kamoshida's abuses.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Could it be that... we're responsible for[n]Principal Kobayakawa's suicide?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Whaddya mean?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: If we hadn't changed Kamoshida's heart,[n]maybe this never would have happened...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But then Kamoshida woulda kept doing[n]what he did if we didn't go and take him[n]down.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: There's a lot of opinions online. "It's only[n]natural that he died." "Covering up crimes[n]is wrong."

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The comments I've seen are similar as[n]well. "Only the Phantom Thieves are on[n]our side!"

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: "I wish the Phantom Thieves would take[n]down the police and the politicians of[n]this country!"

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's not just the news. There's even[n]Phantom Thieves merchandise now.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I never expected we'd end up such[n]a big deal...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems like the public would rather[n]believe in us than in the adults.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: People are trying to get the Phantom[n]Thieves to solve societal problems,[n]not just personal ones.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This is kinda scary...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Are we really doing the right thing?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I mean, the principal was coverin' stuff[n]up, right? I guess... he got what was[n]comin' to him.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Whoa, guys, let's get back on topic.[n]Weren't we going to discuss the data[n]we obtained from Niijima?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You tell them, Inari...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Why me?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: First, Prosecutor Niijima has been[n]looking into the continued cases of[n]people suddenly collapsing.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems she is searching for a common[n]thread to tie them all together.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Some parts seem to be speculation, but[n]she has cited a beneficiary of the majority[n]of these incidents.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The corporation Okumura Foods—more[n]prominently, its CEO, Kunikazu Okumura.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Okumura? I feel like I've heard that name[n]somewhere...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: From Big Bang Burger.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Big Bang Burger!? For real!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You know, they only got famous[n]sometime in the past few years.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: They even had a branch in Hawaii.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It says here they benefited both from[n]scandals and the resignations of their[n]competitors' executives.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That would seem to be the case...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This is too suspicious though. Only one[n]CEO is profiting from these seemingly[n]accidental incidents.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I think it's natural to suspect he's[n]intentionally causing them.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I get that, but still...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We have even more evidence than that.[n]Tell them, Futaba.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I already tried putting Okumura's name[n]in the Nav. He has a Palace for sure.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That settles it then! He's totally our next[n]target!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's right. Okumura is at the top of the[n]rankings, after all.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hold on. That doesn't necessarily mean[n]he's evil. If we jump into this too[n]carelessly...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Beyond that, this Phantom Thieves fad is...[n]unsettling.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah... The excitement levels don't feel[n]normal. We might want to let things[n]calm down a bit first...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You too, Ann!? You're just gonna go[n]against what people want!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh? No, but...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real...?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: L-Looks like we're not gonna agree today[n]then...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Sheesh... Some team you are. What's with[n]all the hesitation? I can't stand this!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Even you, Ryuji! You just back down[n]the second someone disagrees with you!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I guess all you've been talking about is[n]using the Phantom Thieves name to[n]pick up girls anyway.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Being hyped up because of the popularity[n]is fine, but getting conceited over it is[n]unacceptable.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, aren't you actin' for your own[n]benefit here too?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: My appearance might have changed,[n]but I'm still an admirable human!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: At the very least, I'm more admirable[n]than some carnal blond monkey!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You little...!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Fine. I can take on some small-time target[n]like Okumura on my own.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Sorry, but it looks like I'll be getting the[n]credit for solving the mental shutdown[n]mystery.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, she was more useful than you,[n]as a matter of fact.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, that's inexcusable!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...I'm going to show you who the useless[n]one actually is!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right then! Bring it on!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ryuji, stop!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Looks like I don't belong here after all...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, this is goodbye!
What's gotten into you?
Calm down.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Morgana, wait!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...See you.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I bet he's back in no time...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dammit!
